explainTr: Question tag, cümlenin sonuna eklenen kısa sorudur ve 'değil mi?' anlamı taşır: You are a teacher, aren't you? Kural basit: olumlu cümle + olumsuz tag, olumsuz cümle + olumlu tag.
Tag'de cümledeki yardımcı fiili kullanırsın: is → isn't it, can → can't she, has → hasn't he. Present simple'da do/does, past simple'da did gelir: He works here, doesn't he? They left, didn't they?
Özel durumlar: I am → aren't I? Let's → shall we? Emir cümleleri → will you? There is → isn't there? Sesin yükselmesi gerçek soru, düşmesi onay isteme demektir.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede her cümlenin sonuna 'değil mi?' ya da 'öyle mi?' ekleyebilirsin; tek kalıp yeter. İngilizcede tag, cümlenin fiiline göre değişir: aren't you, doesn't she, didn't they, won't he. Bu yüzden önce cümlenin yardımcı fiilini bulmalısın.

examples.en: You're the new teacher, aren't you?
She doesn't work here, does she?
They finished the report, didn't they?

exercises.whyTr: Olumlu cümlenin tag'i olumsuz olur ve aynı yardımcı fiili kullanır: are → aren't you.
Olumsuz cümlenin tag'i olumlu olur: does she.
Cümlede 'can' var, tag'de de can: can't she.
Emir cümlesinin tag'i genelde 'will you?' olur.
'There is' için tag'de de there kullanılır: isn't there.
'I am' için özel tag: aren't I?

reading.title: In the teachers' lounge
reading.text:
At noon, Hafsa went to the teachers' lounge for the first time. It was a small room with a copier, a coffee machine, and two old sofas. Ms. Carter was already there. "You're the new substitute, aren't you?" she asked. "Yes, I am," said Hafsa. "You've met Mr. Lopez, haven't you?" Mr. Lopez, the gym teacher, waved from the table. "Nice to meet you. You don't have a long drive, do you?" "No, I live ten minutes away," Hafsa answered.

The teachers talked about their workload. Ms. Carter had a deadline for grades on Friday, and she was tired. "Lately, we have too many meetings," she said. "Honestly, I need a day off." Mr. Lopez agreed. "There is a rumor that the principal wants another meeting next week, isn't there?" he asked. Ms. Carter laughed. "I didn't hear that. Let's not believe rumors, shall we?"

Hafsa listened carefully and learned many new phrases. She understood most of the conversation, and she even joined it. "The copier is broken again, isn't it?" she asked. Everyone laughed because it was true. Mr. Lopez said, "You'll fit in here, won't you?" "I hope so," said Hafsa. When the bell rang, she felt more confident. A teachers' lounge is not just a place for coffee. It is also a place where new friends begin.

writing.promptTr: Öğretmenler odasında iki kişinin kısa sohbetini yaz. En az 4 question tag kullan (80-100 kelime).
writing.promptEn: Write a short chat between two teachers in the lounge. Use at least 4 question tags (80-100 words).
writing.model: Hafsa: Hello, Linda. You work in room 12, don't you? Linda: Yes, I do. You are the new substitute, aren't you? Hafsa: Yes, I am. It's a busy school, isn't it? Linda: It is, but the staff is friendly. You don't have a long drive, do you? Hafsa: No, I don't. I live near the park. Linda: That's great. The copier is broken today, isn't it? Hafsa: Yes, it is. Let's use the front office, shall we? Linda: Good idea. You'll like this school, won't you? Hafsa: I think so!
checklistTr: En az 4 question tag var mı?
Olumlu cümlede olumsuz tag, olumsuz cümlede olumlu tag kullandın mı?
Tag'deki yardımcı fiil cümleyle uyumlu mu (don't, aren't, isn't ...)?
Tag'den sonra soru işareti koydun mu?

examSet.whyTr: Olumsuz cümle → olumlu tag: are they.
